vb_textbox.text: -it may seem overwhelming at first but throughout the task you will only be shown TWO different pairs of gnomes, of different colours-e.g. you may get a) a red gnome and a green gnome and b) a purple gnome and an orange gnome (this colours are only examples-you will only get these two pairs of gnomes and these gnomes (e.g. the red and green) will always be together-in the early tasks, choose from one of the gnomes from each pair until you get a gnome that delivers a high number of mushrooms (7,8,9) and stick with that gnome until the number of mushrooms begins to decline (4,5,6) then when it reaches two mushrooms switch to the other other gnome-this gnome will probably start out giving you 3 or 4 mushrooms, but with repeated selections the number of mushrooms will gradually rise (9 is the max number)-usually both gnomes mushrooms will begin to drop around the same time so get used to switching over you reflexes to the other gnome in the pair.-always remember to hit the space bar on the forest screen-don't bother paying attention to the colour of the forest
